# Archon Docs — llms.txt

> Archon is an iOS app that lets you build apps by describing them in chat. AI builds it, you browse the code, preview live, and ship.

## What is Archon?
- AI-powered iOS app builder
- Describe your app in chat, AI generates working code
- Browse and edit generated source code with syntax highlighting
- Live preview with WKWebView
- Manage projects, settings, and API configuration

## Key Pages
- [Home](https://relayapp.pro/) — Overview and introduction
- [Features: AI Builder](https://relayapp.pro/features/ai-builder) — Streaming chat with task timeline, model selection, retry/cancel
- [Features: Code Browser](https://relayapp.pro/features/code-browser) — File tree + syntax-highlighted editor
- [Features: Live Preview](https://relayapp.pro/features/live-preview) — WKWebView rendering for HTML apps
- [Features: Projects](https://relayapp.pro/features/projects) — Create, search, organize projects
- [Features: Settings](https://relayapp.pro/features/settings) — Appearance, API keys, account

## Learning Center
Interactive coding lessons with live editors, quizzes, and gamified progress (XP, badges, streaks).
- [Learn Hub](https://relayapp.pro/learn/) — All languages and progress dashboard
- [HTML Fundamentals](https://relayapp.pro/learn/html/01-what-is-html) — 5 lessons: tags, elements, forms, semantic markup
- [CSS Fundamentals](https://relayapp.pro/learn/css/01-what-is-css) — 5 lessons: selectors, box model, flexbox, grid, responsive
- [TypeScript Basics](https://relayapp.pro/learn/typescript/01-what-is-ts) — 5 lessons: variables, functions, interfaces, async
- [Python Basics](https://relayapp.pro/learn/python/01-what-is-python) — 5 lessons: variables, control flow, functions, data structures
- [Swift for iOS](https://relayapp.pro/learn/swift/01-what-is-swift) — 5 lessons: optionals, structs, closures, SwiftUI
- [Java Fundamentals](https://relayapp.pro/learn/java/01-what-is-java) — 5 lessons: variables, OOP, collections, streams

## Developer Docs
Architecture, API reference, and guides for contributing to Archon.
- [Architecture Overview](https://relayapp.pro/dev-docs/architecture/overview) — MVVM, SwiftUI, async/await, Supabase
- [API Overview](https://relayapp.pro/dev-docs/api/overview) — APIClientProtocol, auth, error handling
- [Setup Guide](https://relayapp.pro/dev-docs/guides/setup) — Clone, configure, build with XcodeGen

## Tech Stack
- SwiftUI with iOS 17+ deployment target
- async/await for all async operations
- Supabase Swift SDK for auth and backend
- XcodeGen for project generation
- Keychain for secure session storage
